U.note: Paint-on-grid mixer with three mix modes, a two-colour ramp and a seeded red/blue demo works well, but the side panel is crowded and the seeded demo is small.

V.note: Clean two-colour ratio mixer with a glyph swatch, mean versus linear light and a command prompt; solid and keyboard-friendly, but the ASCII field is a flat dithered block and the prompt is more than a simple mixer needs.

W.note: Pigment bowl with animated glyph blending and kept mixes is a nice idea, but it opens empty and nearly invisible, and the Black label is unreadable.

X.note: Polished, simple two-colour mixer with ASCII swatch, linear toggle, swap, random, copy and full keyboard control; the block-character gradient bar overflows on mobile.

Y.note: Drop-and-paint concept works, but the canvas starts as an empty dotted black box, the bowl preview is a single dull line, and the mobile layout clips on the right.

Z.note: Pigment pots with paint/light/naive models paint onto a seeded colourful ASCII canvas with smudge and keyboard painting; the most engaging and polished at rest and on mobile.
